games.headline: Luka Doncic scores 43, Lakers stretch winning streak to 8 with 131-123 win over Suns
games.desc: — Luka Doncic scored 43 points and the Los Angeles Lakers stretched their winning streak to eight games by holding off the Phoenix Suns 131-123 on Sunday.

games.headline: Darius Garland scores 27 as Clippers run win streak over Hornets to 17 with 113-105 win
games.desc: — Darius Garland scored 27 points, Max Strus had 14 off the bench and the Los Angeles Clippers beat the Charlotte Hornets for the 17th straight time with a 113-105 victory Sunday.

games.headline: Spurs win 12th straight while sending Jazz to 12th straight loss
games.desc: — Dylan Harper had 31 points and nine rebounds to rally the San Antonio Spurs to a 110-102 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday, giving them their 12th straight win, while sending the Jazz to a 12th straight loss.

games.headline: Tatum scores 32, Celtics set franchise history on the way to 131-94 rout of Mavericks
games.desc: — Jayson Tatum scored 32 points in 30 minutes on a night the Boston Celtics set a franchise record for its lead at the end of the opening period on the way to a 131-94 win over the Dallas Mavericks on Sunday night.

games.headline: Brunson hits tiebreaking 3-pointer in OT, Knicks earn 14th straight win over slumping Raptors
games.desc: — Jalen Brunson made a tiebreaking 3-pointer with 33 seconds remaining in overtime and the New York Knicks beat Toronto 112-108 on Sunday night, their 14th straight win over the Raptors.

games.headline: Rockets blow out Wizards 147-119; hold Trae Young scoreless for first time in his career
games.desc: — Amen Thompson scored 26 points and Kevin Durant added 25 to help the Houston Rockets rout the Washington Wizards 147-119 on Sunday night for their fourth straight win.

games.headline: Hawks erase 22-point second quarter deficit to hand Bucks 10th consecutive loss
games.desc: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker and CJ McCollum each scored 20 points and Onyeka Okongwu had 16 and 11 rebounds as the Atlanta Hawks erased a 22-point second-quarter deficit to defeat the Milwaukee Bucks 113-106 on Sunday night.

games.headline: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 37 as Thunder beat Kings 125-103 to snap 3-game losing streak
games.desc: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 37 points in three quarters to help the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Sacramento Kings 125-103 on Sunday night and end a three-game losing streak.
